sections.title: Introduction to Creative Writing: Poetry and Fiction
sections.description: An introduction to writing fiction and poetry. We will focus on the main tools of fiction, such as characterization, dialogue, and description, as well as the forms of poetry, such as sound, image, and enjambment. Suitable for beginners or more experienced writers who want to return to fundamentals. To learn more about this course, visit the Creative Writing Program at https://creative.writing.upenn.edu.
